messages:
Ari (AE): Hey team — pre-sales sync for Acme POC. Customer wants a 2-week pilot. Need to align: success criteria, latency/cost targets, security gates (KMS/VPC), and who owns evals. Can we confirm?
Devon (SE): Quick answers up front: 1) Proposal: 2-week POC with a 1-week ramp + 1 week acceptance window. 2) Acceptance: p50 latency < 200ms for 256-token generation, p95 < 400ms, end-to-end error rate < 0.5%. Quality: 90% pass on their 150 prompt eval set. 3) Cost: target average token cost <= $0.02 / 1k tokens for inference (they want estimate).
Sam (Customer): That looks reasonable. Quality bar: human review on 150 prompts — we’ll mark pass/fail per prompt. Latency: 200ms p50 is ideal, but p95 must be <500ms for live UI. Budget: $8k/mo equivalent for pilot.
Devon (SE): Noted. We should define the eval harness they'll use. Suggest we run two eval modes: live-sampled traffic (10k tokens/day) and synthetic prompt set (their 150 prompts). We'll report accuracy, hallucination rate, and generation length distribution.
Priya (Security): Security checklist: they require KMS integration (customer-managed keys), VPC peering, and audit logs for every request. Also need an export of our data retention policy for logs. They asked about SOC2 scope.
Nikhil (Infra): KMS + VPC possible for Private deployment; Dedicated could work but adds lead time. For a 2-week POC we can offer hosted with customer KMS via envelope encryption + VPC egress restrictions. There's a ~3 business day setup for KMS bindings.
Ari (AE): Action items: Devon — detail the eval plan and sample scripts. Nikhil — confirm setup steps and ETA for KMS binding. Priya — list docs to send for compliance. I'll confirm budget with Sam.
Devon (SE): Eval plan (high-level):
```
- Run 150-prompt suite, collect pass/fail labels
- Synthetic A/B: quantized vs full model for cost/latency tradeoff
- Metrics: accuracy_pct, hallucination_rate, avg_tokens, p50_latency, p95_latency, error_rate
- Acceptance: accuracy_pct >= 90 and hallucination_rate <= 3% and error_rate <= 0.5%
```
Devon (SE): Example curl for perf run (hosted API):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood-1","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Sam (Customer): For the A/B we want to compare a quantized 4-bit variant vs standard 16-bit for latency/cost. If quality delta > 5% we won't accept quantized.
Priya (Security): Send me their security questionnaire. Also note: they require data residency in eu-west-1 for logs. Can we ensure request logs stay in eur region?
Nikhil (Infra): We can pin logging region to eu-west-1 for the customer's tenant on hosted; need legal approval on retention. I'll confirm.
Devon (SE): A couple of potential blockers: 1) If quantization causes >5% accuracy drop we may need to tune prompt templates or fallback to larger model — need to predefine fallback policy. 2) Throughput: their peak of 200 qps will need Dedicated sizing; hosted trial can simulate but won't sustain sustained 200 qps without commit.
Ari (AE): Noted. Sam — can you confirm expected peak QPS during the pilot? If sustained 200 qps we need a different plan.
Sam (Customer): Peak will be bursty, ~50 qps normal, spikes up to 200 qps for a few mins. Pilot traffic should be representative but not full prod.
Devon (SE): Proposed acceptance checklist for SRE/ops handoff:
- Eval report with per-prompt labels and aggregate metrics
- Perf dashboard: p50/p95 latencies, token cost estimate, error rate
- Security artifacts: KMS key ARN, VPC peering ticket, SOC2 excerpt
- Fallthrough policy: if p95 > threshold, route to larger model automatically
Priya (Security): I'll provide the list: SOC2 cert, data retention, KMS procedure doc, and the privacy addendum. Send me the questionnaire.
Ari (AE): Timeline: Day 0-2 onboarding and KMS setup, Day 3-7 ramp + baseline evals, Day 8-12 A/B and stress tests, Day 13-14 acceptance window and wrap. Is everyone ok?
Nikhil (Infra): ETA for KMS binding: 72 hours after we get key ARN. VPC peering could be parallel but requires their infra contact.
Devon (SE): I'll prepare the eval harness and a small repo with runners and a README. I'll also include a notebook to compute metrics (example snippet):
```
def compute_metrics(results):
  total = len(results)
  acc = sum(1 for r in results if r['label']=='pass')/total*100
  hall = sum(1 for r in results if r['hallucinated'])/total*100
  return {'accuracy_pct': f"{acc:.2f}", 'hallucination_rate': f"{hall:.2f}"}
```
Ari (AE): Great. I'll coordinate with procurement for the $8k pilot. Devon/Nikhil/Priya — please post final artifacts in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: KMS binding ticket #45678 created (ETA 72h) :white_check_mark:
Devon (SE): Will do. Will post the repo link and the initial eval CSV here.
Sam (Customer): Thanks — looking forward. We'll send over infra contact for peering and the security questionnaire by EOD.
Ari (AE): Thanks all. Closing this sync — follow-ups in thread. :rocket:
